hooks.name: app_name
hooks.description: The unique internal machine name of the Frappe application (e.g. 'erpnext').

hooks.name: app_title
hooks.description: The human-readable display title of the application.

hooks.name: app_publisher
hooks.description: Name or organization of the application author.

hooks.name: app_description
hooks.description: Short summary description of the application features.
hooks.example: app_description = "Human Resource & Payroll Management Module for Frappe"

hooks.name: app_email
hooks.description: Maintainer / author support email address.

hooks.name: app_license
hooks.description: Open-source / proprietary license type.

hooks.name: app_logo_url
hooks.description: Relative URL path to the application icon/logo.

hooks.name: app_include_js
hooks.description: Global desk JavaScript bundle files loaded on every authenticated page.

hooks.name: app_include_css
hooks.description: Global desk CSS stylesheet bundle loaded on every authenticated page.

hooks.name: web_include_js
hooks.description: Public website / portal JavaScript bundle files.

hooks.name: web_include_css
hooks.description: Public website / portal CSS stylesheets.

hooks.name: doc_events
hooks.description: Subscribes to standard DocType controller events across any app (e.g. before_insert, validate, on_submit, on_cancel).

hooks.name: override_doctype_class
hooks.description: Overrides standard DocType Python controller classes with custom subclassed implementations.

hooks.name: override_whitelisted_methods
hooks.description: Overrides whitelisted Python backend endpoints with custom implementations.

hooks.name: override_doctype_dashboards
hooks.description: Overrides DocType Dashboard connections and transaction charts.

hooks.name: scheduler_events
hooks.description: Registers scheduled cron background jobs (all, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, cron).

hooks.name: doctype_js
hooks.description: Injects additional JavaScript files into standard Form views.

hooks.name: doctype_list_js
hooks.description: Injects custom JavaScript into DocType List Views.

hooks.name: doctype_tree_js
hooks.description: Injects custom JavaScript into Tree-structured DocType views.

hooks.name: page_js
hooks.description: Injects custom JavaScript into Frappe standard or custom Pages.

hooks.name: fixtures
hooks.description: Exports custom records (Custom Fields, Property Setters, Print Formats, Workspaces) into JSON fixtures during 'bench export-fixtures'.

hooks.name: permission_query_conditions
hooks.description: Python function returning custom SQL WHERE conditions to enforce row-level security.

hooks.name: has_permission
hooks.description: Python function returning a boolean permission check for documents.

hooks.name: jinja
hooks.description: Registers custom methods and filters available in Jinja print formats and web templates.

hooks.name: website_route_rules
hooks.description: Custom URL routing patterns and endpoints for portal pages.

hooks.name: website_context
hooks.description: Python function modifying or injecting template context on web pages.

hooks.name: portal_menu_items
hooks.description: Adds menu items to the customer portal sidebar menu.

hooks.name: before_install
hooks.description: Python function executed before app installation onto a site.

hooks.name: after_install
hooks.description: Python function executed immediately after app installation.

hooks.name: before_migrate
hooks.description: Python function executed before bench migrate runs database schema migrations.

hooks.name: after_migrate
hooks.description: Python function executed immediately after bench migrate completes.

hooks.name: before_uninstall
hooks.description: Python function executed before app is uninstalled from site.

hooks.name: after_uninstall
hooks.description: Python function executed after app is uninstalled.

hooks.name: boot_session
hooks.description: Python function adding custom values into frappe.boot sent to client on startup.

hooks.name: on_session_creation
hooks.description: List of Python functions executed when a user logs in.

hooks.name: on_logout
hooks.description: List of Python functions executed when a user logs out.

hooks.name: standard_queries
hooks.description: Overrides standard Link field autocomplete query methods globally.

hooks.name: user_data_fields
hooks.description: GDPR user personal data export and erasure field mappings.

hooks.name: auto_cancel_exempted_doctypes
hooks.description: DocTypes exempted from automatic cancellation when parent document is cancelled.

hooks.name: required_apps
hooks.description: Declares prerequisite Frappe apps required before installing this app.
